decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the following approved drawings, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

A-001 Rev A;
A-004 Rev A;
A-005 Rev A.

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the external materials and finishes specified on the approved drawings:

� External Walls: Painted render to match the existing building
� Windows and Rear Doors: Double-glazed uPVC windows and glazed doors 
� Roof: Flat roof

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1 and DC4 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 4 - Prior to the first occupation or use of the extension hereby approved, the proposed ground-floor window on the north-facing side elevation (serving the kitchen, as shown on Drawing No. A-005 Rev A) shall be fitted with obscure glass (minimum Pilkington Level 3 or equivalent) and shall be non-opening up to a height of 1.7 metres above the finished internal floor level. The window shall be permanently retained in this condition thereafter.

To safeguard the privacy and residential amenity of the occupiers of the adjoining property at No. 38 Old Oak Road, in accordance with Policy HO11 of the Local Plan (2018) and Key Principle HS7 of the Planning Guidance SPD (2018).
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, to the side and rear of the existing back addition following the demolition of existing store room at the rear of the property.
